title: Battery-Powered Fuel Pump – Portable Liquid Pump with Flow Control
descriptionHtml:
Spills and splashes every time you refuel?

Pouring gasoline, diesel or oil from can to tank by hand easily turns into a wet, smelly affair – with spills on the ground, your hands and your clothes. And you can barely get a siphon started.

Pump clean – at the press of a button

The battery-powered pump moves gasoline, diesel and oil quickly and cleanly at up to 2.4 gallons/minute. The flow-control nozzle stops automatically so you avoid spills – no hands in the fuel, no mess.

Features

  • Battery-powered – no cord, no sucking. (Battery not included.)
  • Up to 2.4 gallons/min – empties the can quickly.
  • Flow-control nozzle – stops spills automatically.
  • For gasoline, diesel and oil.
  • Portable and compact – fits in the garage or the boat.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
